annotation_inventory.label: literal_secondary_float

annotation_inventory.label: literal_primary_byte
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set integer high byte zero and low byte from the next bytecode byte; mark integer and resume after one operand.

annotation_inventory.label: literal_secondary_byte
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Load an unsigned byte into secondary integer, clearing its high byte and advancing one operand byte.

annotation_inventory.label: literal_primary_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Build a string descriptor pointing directly to inline bytes after a one-byte length. Move cursor to the first opcode after the string and dispatch without the usual pre-increment.

annotation_inventory.label: literal_secondary_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Point the secondary descriptor at its inline length-prefixed bytes, advance over them and dispatch at the new cursor. The secondary type write occurs only on the page-carry branch; generated use must respect this runtime detail.

annotation_inventory.label: literal_basic_transfer
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read a two-byte address into the bytecode cursor and enter BASIC ROM statement processing at $A8E3.

annotation_inventory.label: op_print_number
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Format primary integer locally or floating value via ROM, emit the text through the ROM printer and add a trailing space.

annotation_inventory.label: format_integer_decimal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Write a signed 16-bit primary integer as decimal into page-one scratch, using decimal_place_values. Suppress leading zeroes, include sign/leading space, terminate with zero and restore the self-modified destination operand.

annotation_inventory.label: decimal_output_pointer_operand
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Mutable low byte of the absolute STA destination at $0C20. Advance after each emitted decimal digit, terminate the page-one string and restore the operand to $01.

annotation_inventory.label: op_print_newline
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Call the BASIC ROM newline routine, then fetch the next compiled operation.

annotation_inventory.label: op_print_spaces
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary to a valid byte count and print that many spaces; used by compiled SPC expressions.

annotation_inventory.label: op_print_tab
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary target column to a byte, subtract current cursor column $D3 and emit spaces only when the target is ahead.

annotation_inventory.label: op_print_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Transfer primary string pointer and length into the ROM string printer, then continue bytecode execution.

annotation_inventory.label: op_print_comma
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Advance to the next ten-column printing zone by reducing current column modulo ten and printing the remaining spaces.

annotation_inventory.label: print_page_one_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Scan the zero-terminated buffer at $0100, point ROM string output to it and print exactly the discovered length.

annotation_inventory.label: op_for_explicit_step
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Build a FOR frame from the evaluated explicit STEP and limit on the processor stack. Choose compact integer representation when exact, otherwise convert operands to six-byte floating records and record the stack position.

annotation_inventory.label: pop_float_preserving_return
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Temporarily remove its machine return address, pop six floating accumulator bytes and resume through an indirect jump instead of RTS.

annotation_inventory.label: push_float_preserving_return
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Remove the helper return address, push six primary float bytes and jump back past the call, leaving the value beneath later stack operands.

annotation_inventory.label: op_for_default_step
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Build a FOR frame with implicit STEP +1. Integer and floating limits have distinct frame layouts; $48 remembers the loop continuation slot.

annotation_inventory.label: op_for_assign
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read the loop-variable pointer, discard an older matching FOR frame, save loop continuation and assign its initial value. Mark frame layout for integer/float/forced-integer arithmetic, reporting stack exhaustion via BASIC errors.

annotation_inventory.label: float_is_exact_integer
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Test exponent and fractional mantissa bits to decide whether primary floating value fits exact signed 16-bit integer representation. Zero result permits integer conversion.

annotation_inventory.label: float_integer_test_return
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Final RTS of the exact-integer float test. Indexed mask reads use this address as a one-byte-before base; actual masks begin at $0EDF.

annotation_inventory.label: integer_fraction_masks
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Eight masks $7F,$3F,$1F,$0F,$07,$03,$01,$00, indexed using base $0EDE. They test whether a floating accumulator can be stored as an exact 16-bit integer.

annotation_inventory.label: op_next_loop
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Pop FOR metadata with interrupts disabled, advance the loop variable by its saved step and compare to the saved limit. Restore cursor/stack and continue the body while in range; otherwise discard the loop continuation. Promote overflowed non-forced integers to float.

annotation_inventory.label: next_float_loop
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Floating FOR continuation: recover step and limit from the frame, convert an integer variable if required, add step, store the updated value and compare according to step sign.

annotation_inventory.label: next_promoted_integer_loop
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Handle integer FOR arithmetic that promoted its variable to floating representation, rebuilding step/limit records before returning to the loop body.

annotation_inventory.label: store_float_loop_variable
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Clear the loop variable type byte and copy all six primary floating fields into the pointed scalar record.

annotation_inventory.label: op_next_named_variable
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read the requested loop pointer in high/low order from bytecode, search nested FOR frames and discard intervening loops until it matches, then run normal NEXT.

annotation_inventory.label: secondary_int_to_float
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert secondary signed 16-bit integer (or explicit high/low A/Y entry at $10DF) into normalized six-byte floating form. Preserve sign separately and normalize the mantissa by byte/bit shifts.

annotation_inventory.label: secondary_ay_to_float
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Alternate conversion entry with signed integer high byte in A and low byte in Y. Normalize magnitude into the secondary float accumulator and retain its sign.

annotation_inventory.label: secondary_float_to_integer
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Check secondary float against signed 16-bit bounds, shift mantissa to an integer through ROM helpers and apply two-complement sign. Out-of-range input enters the ROM quantity error.

annotation_inventory.label: op_bitwise_and
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Coerce primary/secondary numeric values to integers when needed and AND their corresponding 16-bit halves into primary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_bitwise_or
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Coerce both operands to 16-bit integers and OR them into primary.

annotation_inventory.label: coerce_two_integers
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert whichever numeric accumulators are floating using the local secondary and ROM primary conversion helpers.

annotation_inventory.label: op_bitwise_not
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Coerce primary numeric value to integer and invert both bytes, yielding BASIC-style bitwise NOT.

annotation_inventory.label: op_numeric_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compare numeric operands and return signed integer -1 on equality, zero otherwise.

annotation_inventory.label: op_numeric_not_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Return -1 when numeric operands differ; equality gives zero.

annotation_inventory.label: op_numeric_less
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Return -1 when primary is less than secondary, else zero.

annotation_inventory.label: op_numeric_greater
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Return -1 when primary is greater than secondary, else zero.

annotation_inventory.label: op_numeric_less_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Accept comparison bits less or equal and return BASIC boolean -1/0.

annotation_inventory.label: op_numeric_greater_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Accept comparison bits greater or equal and return BASIC boolean -1/0.

annotation_inventory.label: compare_numeric_values
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compare signed integers directly or normalize mixed numeric types and compare floats. Result bits are 1=primary less, 2=greater, 4=equal.

annotation_inventory.label: compare_float_values
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compare float signs, exponent and mantissa, reversing ordering for negative values; returns the shared numeric relation mask.

annotation_inventory.label: reverse_numeric_relation
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Swap less/greater relation bits while preserving equality. Negative float comparisons call this after comparing magnitudes; the following $129C entry performs the raw exponent/mantissa comparison.

annotation_inventory.label: op_conditional_skip
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: If primary numeric value is nonzero skip the one-byte displacement operand; if zero add that operand to the cursor before fetching the next opcode. Branch destination is opcode address+1+displacement.

annotation_inventory.label: op_jump
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read inline little-endian bytecode destination, replace cursor and dispatch there without pre-increment.

annotation_inventory.label: op_gosub
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Check stack headroom, push continuation cursor with marker $A4, then enter the inline absolute jump target.

annotation_inventory.label: op_return
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Pop until a $A4 GOSUB frame is found, discarding nested FOR frames according to their layouts. Restore its cursor or raise RETURN-without-GOSUB through ROM.

annotation_inventory.label: op_on_branch
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Primary is a one-based branch index. Read table byte length and GOTO/GOSUB selector, select an inline destination or skip the table if zero/outside its entries; GOSUB also pushes the post-table continuation.

annotation_inventory.label: op_push_primary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Push primary integer, string descriptor or rounded six-byte float followed by its type tag onto the 6502 stack for expression evaluation.

annotation_inventory.label: op_pop_primary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Pop a tagged temporary value into primary accumulator, respecting integer/string/floating layouts.

annotation_inventory.label: op_pop_secondary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Pop a tagged temporary value into the secondary accumulator for a binary expression.

annotation_inventory.label: op_primary_zero
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Produce typed integer zero in primary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_secondary_zero
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Produce typed integer zero in secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_primary_one
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Produce typed integer one in primary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_secondary_one
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Produce typed integer one in secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_begin_input
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Clear field offset $0B and reset the mutable INPUT retry sentinel to $FF.

annotation_inventory.label: input_retry_flag
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Mutable INPUT retry sentinel. $142C writes $FF and numeric/string INPUT increments it. The following executable entry starts at $1438, so this byte is not an undocumented opcode.

annotation_inventory.label: retry_numeric_input
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Check current channel/status and STOP state, request another line when needed, then continue numeric field parsing.

annotation_inventory.label: op_input_number
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Parse a signed decimal field from the input buffer, optimizing up to five digits as integer and using ROM conversion for decimal/exponent or overflow cases. Track comma-separated field position and support fused following stores.

annotation_inventory.label: primary_integer_zero
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Initialize primary to typed integer zero and return to a machine-code caller.

annotation_inventory.label: negate_primary_integer
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Two-complement both primary integer bytes in place, carrying low-byte increment into high.

annotation_inventory.label: advance_bytecode_cursor
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Increment the 16-bit bytecode cursor by one with page carry.

annotation_inventory.label: check_input_stop
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compare keyboard status $91 to $7F and transfer to the runtime STOP path when matched.

annotation_inventory.label: scan_input_field_end
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Scan the $0200 input line to comma or zero while toggling the quote-state flag on double quotes; return the delimiter and next offset.

annotation_inventory.label: retry_string_input
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: For console input return to BASIC on an empty line; for file input check EOF/status and retry state, otherwise read a new field.

annotation_inventory.label: op_input_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Skip leading spaces, handle quoted comma-separated input, allocate a heap string for the selected field and advance the input cursor. Support a following fused scalar store.

annotation_inventory.label: op_read_number
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read a packed DATA record via $41/$42: integer-byte, integer-word or textual numeric form selected by the header bits. Advance the DATA pointer and feed the common assignment continuation; $FF signals out-of-data.

annotation_inventory.label: advance_data_pointer
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Add A plus one to the packed DATA pointer, accounting for its header byte.

annotation_inventory.label: point_after_data_header
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set ROM text pointer $22/$23 to one byte past the DATA record header.

annotation_inventory.label: op_read_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Expose the next packed DATA item as a string descriptor, using low six length bits and representation flags to advance the DATA cursor correctly.

annotation_inventory.label: op_restore_data
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Reset DATA pointer from the compiled image header at $081C/$081D.

annotation_inventory.label: primary_to_float
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert an integer primary through ROM signed integer-to-float; leave a floating primary untouched.

annotation_inventory.label: op_cursor_position
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Return KERNAL cursor column $D3 as an integer.

annotation_inventory.label: op_integer_part
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Use ROM INT for a floating primary and compress to integer if exact/in-range; existing integer values pass through.

annotation_inventory.label: op_sign
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Return -1,0,+1 for primary numeric sign, using ROM float sign or local integer sign.

annotation_inventory.label: op_absolute_value
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Clear floating sign or two-complement a negative integer, then resume bytecode.

annotation_inventory.label: integer_sign
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Return Y=-1,0,+1 from the signed primary integer.

annotation_inventory.label: op_random
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Call ROM RND for floating input or pass the sign of integer input to the corresponding ROM entry; result is floating primary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_square_root
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary to float and call BASIC ROM square root at $BF71.

annotation_inventory.label: op_exponential
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary to float and call the ROM exponential function $BFED.

annotation_inventory.label: op_cosine
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Normalize primary numeric type and call ROM COS at $E264.

annotation_inventory.label: op_sine
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Normalize primary numeric type and call ROM SIN at $E26B.

annotation_inventory.label: op_logarithm
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary to float and call ROM LOG at $B9EA.

annotation_inventory.label: op_tangent
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary to float and call ROM TAN at $E2B4.

annotation_inventory.label: op_arctangent
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary to float and call ROM ATN at $E30E.

annotation_inventory.label: op_machine_call
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Push the dispatcher return address and jump to the primary numeric address, converting floats through ROM. SYS uses carry-set entry; the carry-clear USR entry calls vector $0311 after numeric normalization.

annotation_inventory.label: op_usr
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Clear carry and enter the shared machine-call helper to invoke the USR vector at $0311.

annotation_inventory.label: op_poke
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Validate primary as byte value, pop its target address from the expression stack, convert numeric address as needed and store through zero-page pointer $14/$15.

annotation_inventory.label: primary_to_byte
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary float to integer if required and require its high byte to be zero; otherwise raise illegal-quantity error.

annotation_inventory.label: primary_to_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary through ROM integer conversion and copy low/high into $14/$15.

annotation_inventory.label: op_peek
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert primary numeric address, read one byte through $14/$15 and return an unsigned integer.

annotation_inventory.label: op_get_number
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Fetch a character through KERNAL GETIN; accept a decimal digit as integer, return zero for no input and enter ROM error handling for nonnumeric characters.

annotation_inventory.label: op_get_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Fetch one KERNAL character, allocate a one-byte string if present or an empty string otherwise, then continue through string assignment.

annotation_inventory.label: op_wait_xor_mask
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Take primary XOR mask, pop AND mask and address, then poll the byte until (value XOR xor_mask) AND mask is nonzero.

annotation_inventory.label: op_wait_mask
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set XOR mask zero and share WAIT polling with a popped address and primary AND mask.

annotation_inventory.label: op_stop_at
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read inline source/cursor address, preserve it in the bytecode cursor and return through BASIC STOP processing.

annotation_inventory.label: op_open_defaults
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: OPEN with device 1 and secondary $FF defaults; the following entries progressively obtain missing arguments from tagged expression-stack values.

annotation_inventory.label: op_open_device
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set default secondary $FF then share OPEN argument extraction and KERNAL OPEN.

annotation_inventory.label: op_open_secondary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Use dispatcher index to select which device/secondary arguments to pop, clear filename length, then OPEN the evaluated logical file.

annotation_inventory.label: op_open_filename
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Copy primary string descriptor into KERNAL filename fields, then pop secondary address, device and logical file values before OPEN.

annotation_inventory.label: op_close
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Validate primary logical file number and invoke KERNAL CLOSE.

annotation_inventory.label: op_output_channel
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Select logical output channel using KERNAL CHKOUT and set the runtime channel marker.

annotation_inventory.label: op_input_channel
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Select logical input channel with KERNAL CHKIN and remember it for INPUT status handling.

annotation_inventory.label: op_default_channels
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Invoke CLRCHN and clear the runtime nondefault-channel marker $13.

annotation_inventory.label: pop_value_preserving_return
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Remove the helper return address, pop the prior tagged numeric value into primary, then jump back; floating values share the six-byte pop helper.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_load_default
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set device 1 and secondary zero before entering the compiled LOAD setup.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_load_secondary_one
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set secondary address 1, pop filename/device operands and load through the compiled restart path.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_load_secondary_zero
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set secondary address 0, consume device and filename, reset KERNAL load state and processor stack, preserve runtime allocation pointers and invoke LOAD.

annotation_inventory.label: op_extended
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read one-byte extended operation index, double it and jump through the nineteen-word table at $1998.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_opcode_handlers
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Nineteen little-endian machine entry addresses selected by opcode $80 plus one byte. They cover LOAD variants, ST/TI/TI$ reads, clock assignment, PI constants and keyboard-polling toggles.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_handler_high
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: High-byte access into the interleaved extended-operation vectors. Nineteen little-endian machine entry addresses selected by opcode $80 plus one byte. They cover LOAD variants, ST/TI/TI$ reads, clock assignment, PI constants and keyboard-polling toggles.

annotation_inventory.label: enable_bytecode_stop_poll
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Patch the dispatcher first three bytes to JMP $19DE so keyboard status is checked on every opcode.

annotation_inventory.label: disable_bytecode_stop_poll
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Restore the fast cursor increment dispatcher and resume the compiled program.

annotation_inventory.label: restore_fast_dispatcher
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Copy the three-byte INC $39/BNE template over the optional keyboard-poll jump.

annotation_inventory.label: checked_bytecode_fetch
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Check keyboard status $91 against $EF, stop through BASIC if matched, otherwise increment cursor and dispatch normally.

annotation_inventory.label: dispatcher_patch_bytes
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Two three-byte templates: JMP $19DE enables keyboard checking at each bytecode fetch; INC $39 / BNE opcode prefix restores the fast dispatcher. $19BE and $19D2 copy the selected template.

annotation_inventory.label: fast_dispatch_template
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Three bytes E6 39 D0 restore the fast opcode fetch prefix. Two three-byte templates: JMP $19DE enables keyboard checking at each bytecode fetch; INC $39 / BNE opcode prefix restores the fast dispatcher. $19BE and $19D2 copy the selected template.

annotation_inventory.label: coerce_mixed_floats
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Select which accumulator is integer and convert it so mixed arithmetic can use ROM floating operations.

annotation_inventory.label: primary_integer_to_float
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Load primary signed integer high/low into A/Y, call ROM conversion $B391 and mark primary floating; the adjacent branch converts secondary instead.

annotation_inventory.label: swap_numeric_accumulators
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Swap integer pairs directly, or normalize mixed types then exchange seven floating fields and clear rounding extension.

annotation_inventory.label: swap_float_fields
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Exchange seven fields between primary and secondary floating accumulators, then clear the rounding extension. The following conversion entries normalize integer operands before joining this swap.

annotation_inventory.label: restore_overflow_operands
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Convert saved integer operands back to the two floating accumulators after an integer arithmetic overflow.

annotation_inventory.label: restore_primary_overflow_operand
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Reload the saved original integer from $30/$2F and convert it to primary float after arithmetic overflow. The preceding entry also restores secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_negate
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Two-complement a primary integer or invert its floating sign byte.

annotation_inventory.label: op_add
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Add signed integers directly and promote on overflow; mixed/floating operands use ROM addition after type normalization.

annotation_inventory.label: op_secondary_minus_primary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compute B-A in integer form where possible; preserve originals for promotion on overflow, otherwise call ROM subtraction.

annotation_inventory.label: op_primary_minus_secondary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compute A-B, with the same integer overflow promotion and a reversed floating subtraction/sign path.

annotation_inventory.label: op_multiply
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Use sixteen shift/add steps with a wide scratch product for integer operands; keep a signed-16 result when valid, otherwise promote originals and use ROM multiply. Shared continuation also serves integer powers.

annotation_inventory.label: op_primary_divided_secondary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Swap numeric operands then enter the division path so this variant returns A/B.

annotation_inventory.label: op_secondary_divided_primary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Normalize operands to floats and call the ROM division entry to compute B/A.

annotation_inventory.label: op_secondary_power_primary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Optimize nonnegative small integer exponents, including zero, one and powers of two; repeated multiplication promotes to ROM exponentiation if bounds or integer range require it.

annotation_inventory.label: op_primary_power_secondary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Swap exponent/base operands and share the integer/float exponentiation implementation.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_length
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Move primary string length into integer low byte and clear its high byte.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_to_number
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Parse primary string through ROM numeric conversion, returning integer when exact/in-range and floating otherwise; empty input gives zero.

annotation_inventory.label: compare_strings
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compare bytes lexicographically up to the shorter length, then lengths. String relation bits are 2=primary less, 1=greater, 4=equal, opposite to numeric ordering bits.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compare the string descriptors and return BASIC boolean -1 on equality, zero otherwise.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_not_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Use either unequal string relation bit to produce -1/0 integer truth.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_less
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Choose relation mask 2 and compare primary string lexically less than secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_greater
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Choose relation mask 1 for primary string greater than secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_less_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Choose relation mask 6 to accept primary string less than or equal to secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_string_greater_equal
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Choose relation mask 5 for primary string greater than or equal to secondary and return a numeric boolean.

annotation_inventory.label: retry_string_allocation
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: On the first heap collision run garbage collection, mark one retry and duplicate the string again; a repeated collision raises out-of-memory.

annotation_inventory.label: copy_primary_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Use primary string descriptor as the source for the heap string-copy helper.

annotation_inventory.label: allocate_string_copy
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Y is length and $24/$25 source. Allocate downward from $33/$34, copy bytes and append length plus unowned marker $FF; return descriptor and detect collision with the lower heap bound.

annotation_inventory.label: op_concatenate_secondary_primary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Allocate combined length plus metadata, copy secondary bytes then primary bytes, return the new string and collect/retry if the heap meets its floor.

annotation_inventory.label: op_concatenate_primary_secondary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Swap the two string descriptors before the common concatenation routine to produce A$+B$.

annotation_inventory.label: op_left_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Primary is requested length; clip it to secondary string length and allocate/copy the left substring.

annotation_inventory.label: op_right_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Clip requested length and advance source pointer to the rightmost bytes of secondary string before copying.

annotation_inventory.label: op_number_to_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Format primary integer locally or float through ROM, measure the page-one text and copy it into a managed heap string.

annotation_inventory.label: op_character_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Validate primary as one byte, place it in temporary storage and allocate a length-one string.

annotation_inventory.label: return_empty_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set length and pointer high byte zero, mark string type and continue dispatch.

annotation_inventory.label: op_mid_with_length
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Use length saved in $60 and one-based position in secondary to clip/copy a substring of primary string; invalid zero/large positions raise quantity error.

annotation_inventory.label: op_mid_one_character
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Set substring length one then share MID clipping and copying.

annotation_inventory.label: op_set_substring_length
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Validate primary as a byte and save it at $60 for the following MID operation.

annotation_inventory.label: op_mid_to_end
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Primary is one-based position and secondary the string. Copy all remaining characters from that position, returning empty when beyond the string.

annotation_inventory.label: op_character_code
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Require nonempty primary string and return its first byte as an integer.

annotation_inventory.label: op_free_string_memory
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Run garbage collection and subtract allocation-floor pointer $31/$32 from heap-top $33/$34, returning free byte count as integer.

annotation_inventory.label: index_float_array
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Multiply primary index by five and add array base $49/$4A. Dispatcher variant either saves destination pointer or reads packed numeric element, whose zero exponent denotes compact integer.

annotation_inventory.label: index_integer_array
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Multiply index by two, add array base and either save destination or read a two-byte integer element according to opcode variant.

annotation_inventory.label: index_string_array
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compute base+3*index and either save destination or read a three-byte string descriptor.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_integer_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Consume inline pointer and load its two-byte packed integer into primary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_numeric_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Consume inline pointer and load its five-byte packed numeric value into primary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_string_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Consume inline pointer and read its three-byte descriptor into primary string fields.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_secondary_integer_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Consume inline pointer and load a two-byte integer into secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_secondary_numeric_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read packed numeric data through an inline pointer; exponent zero selects compact integer, otherwise unpack sign/mantissa to secondary float.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_secondary_string_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read length and pointer from an inline string descriptor into secondary fields.

annotation_inventory.label: op_store_integer_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read inline destination pointer, then coerce primary and store its two-byte integer representation.

annotation_inventory.label: store_integer_destination
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Store primary high/low integer bytes through the prepared destination pointer; convert floating input first.

annotation_inventory.label: op_store_value_address
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read an inline pointer into the prepared destination, then store numeric or string primary in packed form.

annotation_inventory.label: store_value_destination
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Pack primary into prepared array/scalar destination: exact integers use zero exponent plus two bytes, floats use five bytes with embedded sign, and strings use the ownership-aware descriptor path.

annotation_inventory.label: store_string_destination
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Release the old managed string, copy a shared incoming string if necessary, attach the destination back-reference and write length/pointer descriptor.

annotation_inventory.label: op_select_array_base
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Load two inline address bytes into $49/$4A and resume at the opcode after them.

annotation_inventory.label: read_inline_pointer
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Fetch little-endian inline pointer into $2F/$30, advance cursor over two bytes and return Y=0.

annotation_inventory.label: index_two_dimensional_array
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read stride/type from three bytes before array base, compute primary_index*stride+secondary_index, then dispatch to two-,three- or five-byte element addressing for load/store variant.

annotation_inventory.label: decimal_place_values
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Five little-endian integers 10000,1000,100,10,1. Runtime decimal input/output uses repeated addition/subtraction rather than requiring floating-point conversion.

annotation_inventory.label: decimal_place_value_high
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: High-byte access into the five decimal-place words. Five little-endian integers 10000,1000,100,10,1. Runtime decimal input/output uses repeated addition/subtraction rather than requiring floating-point conversion.

annotation_inventory.label: load_restart_flag
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Mutable flag set before a compiled LOAD and cleared at program entry; a nonzero value skips full variable reinitialization on re-entry.

annotation_inventory.label: compiled_program_start
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Initialize the compiled GAME program from its header: bytecode cursor from $0822/$0823, allocation pointer from $0824/$0825, variable-table limit from $081C/$081D. On the first entry clear variables and arrays through $2281, close KERNAL channels, reset the 6502 stack to $F8, and enter the bytecode dispatcher at $0926.

annotation_inventory.label: op_clear_runtime
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Clear scalar and array storage through initialization and close KERNAL channels before resetting the execution stack and transient interpreter state.

annotation_inventory.label: initialize_compiled_variables
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Clear scalar records starting $2800 while preserving forced-integer/string declarations; use eight-byte stride in page $28 and seven thereafter. Clear the array interval from header and apply five-byte initializer records until type $64 terminator.

annotation_inventory.label: scalar_clear_destination_operand
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Self-modified low/high address operand of STA $0000,Y at $22A1. The initializer advances this destination over scalar records while preserving their type declarations, then clears arrays and applies initializers.

annotation_inventory.label: scalar_clear_destination_high
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: High byte of the self-modified STA operand at $22A1. Together with $22A2 it walks scalar records during initialization; subsequent code preserves declarations, clears arrays and loads initial values.

annotation_inventory.label: array_clear_operand_low
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Low byte of the self-modified STA operand at $22F7. Startup clears the header-defined array interval then reads five-byte initialization records until type $64.

annotation_inventory.label: array_clear_operand_high
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: High byte of the array-clear destination. INC at $22FF carries page crossings; CPX compares against the header end pointer before initializer records are applied.

annotation_inventory.label: op_new_basic
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Invoke ROM NEW/cleanup and return to BASIC ready processing.

annotation_inventory.label: op_end_basic
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Invoke BASIC cleanup then return to the ROM ready loop.

annotation_inventory.label: op_define_function
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read function descriptor pointer, store inline bytecode-body address at offsets 3/4, and skip the function body by the inline byte count.

annotation_inventory.label: op_save_local_variable
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read scalar pointer, push its typed old value plus pointer/tag, verify stack headroom and assign primary through the generic scalar store.

annotation_inventory.label: op_restore_local_variable
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Pop saved scalar pointer and old typed value from a function/local frame and restore its record.

annotation_inventory.label: op_call_defined_function
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read descriptor pointer, push a normal GOSUB continuation, fetch its body address at offsets 3/4 and dispatch there.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_extended_primary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read one-byte extended scalar index and address seven-byte records from $2900. Load its typed integer/string or float into primary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_load_extended_secondary
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read one-byte extended index, compute $2900+7*index and load the typed scalar into secondary.

annotation_inventory.label: op_store_extended_scalar
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Compute the extended scalar address from one-byte index, then store primary through the type-preserving scalar assignment routine.

annotation_inventory.label: store_generic_scalar
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Preserve forced-integer type, compress exact floats, copy full floating fields or manage string ownership before updating the pointed seven/eight-byte scalar record.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_primary_status
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read KERNAL status $90 as a sign-extended integer into primary.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_secondary_status
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read the same KERNAL status byte into secondary with sign extension.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_numeric_clock
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read the system clock through BASIC ROM, return compact integer where it fits or floating value otherwise; dispatcher index selects primary versus secondary destination.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_string_clock
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read system clock, convert it to six decimal digits via ROM and allocate a managed string; select primary or secondary by extended operation index.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_set_clock_string
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Require a six-character primary string, point the BASIC parser to it and invoke ROM clock-string assignment.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_primary_pi
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Copy the six-byte pi constant into primary and mark floating type.

annotation_inventory.label: extended_secondary_pi
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Copy pi into secondary exponent/mantissa/sign and mark floating type.

annotation_inventory.label: pi_table_prebase_operand
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: High byte $09 of the preceding JMP $0926, also used as the one-byte-before base for indexed pi reads. The actual six-byte constant starts at $2677.

annotation_inventory.label: pi_float_constant
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Six-byte unpacked floating representation of pi: exponent, four mantissa bytes and sign. Extended operations copy it into the primary or secondary accumulator.

annotation_inventory.label: collect_string_garbage
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Scan tagged expression-stack values to preserve live string references, compact the heap through $270D, then repair temporary stack descriptors from the recorded back-references.

annotation_inventory.label: compact_string_heap
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Walk managed strings downward from the configured memory ceiling, skip unowned/free records, move live strings together and update their owning descriptors. Return the reclaimed heap-top pointer in $33/$34.

annotation_inventory.label: retreat_heap_record
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Retreat destination pointer by two metadata bytes, then source pointer by two using the shared subtract helpers.

annotation_inventory.label: retreat_heap_source
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Subtract two (or A through $27C9) from the source heap cursor $4E/$4F.

annotation_inventory.label: retreat_heap_source_by_a
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Subtract caller-supplied A from the 16-bit heap source cursor $4E/$4F, preserving borrow across the high byte.

annotation_inventory.label: retreat_heap_destination
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Subtract A from destination heap cursor $5F/$60, returning low/high in A/Y.

annotation_inventory.label: read_string_owner_pointer
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Read the two-byte owner back-reference from the current heap record into $22/$23.

annotation_inventory.label: runtime_build_tags
annotation_inventory.baseline_comment: Fourteen resident bytes containing TROLLY and STGARB with separators. They are not reached by the traced runtime; code ends with the descriptor helper RTS at $27F1.
